name: FollowDistance
description: Set how close follower(s) walk behind the player.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for followers.

distance.description: The follow distance, exactly one of: near, normal, far.

prompt: If the player asks you to follow closer, keep more distance or follow normally, begin your response with '{key}:'
